headline: 📋 Triborough Works HR has sent a company-wide email titled 'Let's Talk About Credit.' It is 3,000 words long. Sabotage at Pivotly gets traced twice as often this week.

condition.subject: tech
condition.title: HR crackdown at Pivotly
condition.blurb: Too much credit-taking at Pivotly. HR is reading the Slack. Office sabotage there gets traced twice as often this week.

effects.note: 📋 HR is 'just observing' from the kitchen. Sabotage here gets traced twice as often this week.

headline: 📋 Clout TV management has banned the word 'allegedly' from the break room. Rumors at the Tower get traced twice as often this week.

condition.subject: media
condition.title: HR crackdown at Clout TV
condition.blurb: Too many rumors at the Tower. HR installed a suggestion box. It is a camera. Office sabotage there gets traced twice as often this week.

effects.note: 📋 HR is 'just observing' from the green room. Sabotage here gets traced twice as often this week.

headline: 🚪 After a rowdy few nights, Queens' clubs have hired extra bouncers. Cover charges are up, and so is the attitude.

condition.title: The clubs tighten the door
condition.blurb: Too many people got thrown out this week. Every club in Queens added a bouncer and raised the cover. Behave accordingly.

effects.reason: The door tightened after a rowdy week: cover is up

headline: 🎟️ Lucky Star Lotto reports 'unprecedented luck' in Flushing. The line is around the block. The odds have not changed. Nobody cares.

condition.title: Lotto fever in Flushing
condition.blurb: Everyone heard someone won something. The line at Lucky Star is around the block and the food court next door is very happy about it.

effects.reason: Lotto fever: the line from Lucky Star ends here

effects.note: 🎟️ The line is around the block. A man is selling folding chairs to the line.

headline: 🔍 The Mayor's office announced an ethics probe into 'recent campaign irregularities.' The probe's first meeting was catered. By a donor.

condition.title: City Hall's ethics probe
condition.blurb: Too many dirty wins. City Hall opened an ethics probe. Campaign HQ is suddenly very interested in its own paperwork.

effects.note: 🔍 Bernie is shredding nothing. Loudly. 'For the record, I am shredding nothing.'

headline: 🚔 The 114½ Precinct is at capacity. Sgt. Bev has started a waitlist and a group chat.

condition.title: The 114½ is full
condition.blurb: Busy night for the 114½. The holding cell has a waitlist, a group chat and a surprisingly good playlist.

effects.note: 🚔 Sgt. Bev: 'We're full. Commit your crimes tomorrow, please.'

headline: 🪩 Queens partied so hard last night the rooftops raised their prices this morning. Lola has never been prouder.

condition.title: Queens is partying
condition.blurb: Everyone went out last night, and everyone's going out again. The rooftops noticed and adjusted their prices accordingly.

effects.reason: Party surge: the rooftops know you're coming

headline: 🕺 Subway showtime crews report record tips. The Metro Rail Authority reports record 'concerns.'

condition.title: Showtime season
condition.blurb: The showtime crews are having a moment. Hold onto the pole. Or don't, and become part of the act.

effects.note: 🕺 A showtime crew is rehearsing on the platform. The pigeons are judging.
